mapper.sql: id, term, normalized_term, category, action, language, is_exemption, note, is_active, data_version, created_by, created_at, updated_at

where.if: AND (term ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR normalized_term ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR note ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%'))

mapper.select: SELECT FROM moderation_terms WHERE is_active = TRUE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO moderation_terms (id, term, normalized_term, category, action, language, is_exemption, note, is_active, data_version, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{term}, #{normalizedTerm}, #{category}, #{action}, #{language}, #{isExemption}, #{note}, #{isActive}, #{dataVersion}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE moderation_terms SET term = #{term}, normalized_term = #{normalizedTerm}, category = #{category}, action = #{action}, language = #{language}, is_exemption = #{isExemption}, note = #{note}, is_active = #{isActive}, data_version = data_version + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND data_version = #{dataVersion}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO moderation_term_audit (term_id, action, before_value, after_value, changed_by) VALUES (#{termId}, #{action}, #{beforeValue}::jsonb, #{afterValue}::jsonb, #{changedBy})
